title: SAML entity metadata verification + rollback UX for setup wizard
creator: Ava Chen
description: Add a robust metadata exchange and validation flow to the SAML 2.0 setup wizard that performs entity certificate fingerprint validation, detects metadata diffs, records deterministic audit events, and exposes an admin-facing rollback/preview UX guarded by RBAC v2. Goal: reduce onboarding failures and prevent silent identity provider (IdP) misconfigurations while preserving a safe rollback path for operators.
acceptance_criteria: Setup wizard accepts IdP metadata via URL upload and pasted XML and computes SHA256 fingerprint of signing/encryption certs
Validation step flags mismatched entityID, expired certificates, missing SingleSignOnService or SingleLogoutService endpoints, and algorithm compatibility (RSA vs ECDSA)
Metadata apply operation creates an immutable metadata version and writes an audit record with who/what/when/prev_version and a human-readable diff
Only users with 'sso.admin' role (RBAC v2) can apply changes that affect production assignments; others get a preview-only flow
A rollback UI shows last 3 metadata versions, diff preview, and requires review confirmation; rollback actions are auditable and emit structured audit events
Automated nightly metadata refresh respects TTL and emits warnings to owners when certs expire within 30 days
E2E test harness covers metadata import -> validate -> apply -> rollback and verifies audit log entries and RBAC enforcement
implementation_notes: Backend: new /api/sso/metadata/validate and /api/sso/metadata/apply endpoints. Validate returns structured findings and canonicalized XML fingerprint(s)
Store: metadata_versions table with columns: id (uuid), created_by, created_at, raw_xml, canonicalized_xml, cert_fingerprints (list), previous_id
Audit: wire events into existing audit-log pipeline as JSON blobs: {actor, action, target, prev_version_id, diff_summary, trace_id}
RBAC: gate apply/rollback endpoints with policy 'sso.admin' using RBAC v2 middleware; UI should gray out apply button for insufficient permissions and show required role tooltip
UI: wizard step 'Verify Metadata' shows entityID, cert fingerprint (sha256 base64), endpoints, algorithms, and detected issues with severity tags
Diffing: use XML canonicalization (C14N) then compute line-oriented diff for human display. Also compute a semantic delta: endpoints added/removed, cert changed, entityID changed
Cert rotation: Accept metadata where only cert rotates if entityID and endpoints unchanged; treat cert change as high-severity but allow admin apply with second-factor confirmation
Telemetry: emit metrics for validation failures by type to monitor common onboarding issues

Trade-offs: strict validation reduces production surprises but increases friction for IdPs that publish non-canonical XML; will provide a permissive toggle for enterprise SSO pilots behind feature flag

2025-02-03 - Diego Marquez: Spiked implementation for fingerprint extraction. Using python-xmlsec to pull X509Certificate nodes and compute sha256 of decoded DER. Found edge case: metadata with multiple <KeyDescriptor> entries for signing/encryption ordering varies.

notes_on_edge_cases: IdPs publishing metadata with XML comments or extraneous whitespace must be canonicalized: implement C14N before diffing
Multiple certificates: pick signing cert by KeyUsage and prioritize explicit use="signing" attributes; if ambiguous, surface to operator
Expired certs: wizard should allow 'import for staging' but block production apply unless admin explicitly overrides
IdP that rotates cert and also changes entityID: treat as new integration and require manual verification flow
